action.new_str:
import pytest

from toyapp.catalog import browse_next
from toyapp.pagination import CursorPage, page_numbers, paginate, paginate_cursor
from toyapp.tokens import encode_offset


def test_page_number_api_remains_one_based() -> None:
    assert paginate(["a", "b", "c"], page=1, per_page=2).items == ["a", "b"]
    assert paginate(["a", "b", "c"], page=2, per_page=2).items == ["c"]


def test_page_number_validation_is_preserved() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate(["a"], page=0, per_page=1)
    assert page_numbers(5, 2) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_cursor_page_walks_pages_preserving_order() -> None:
    items = list(range(5))
    first = paginate_cursor(items, per_page=2)
    assert isinstance(first, CursorPage)
    assert first.items == [0, 1]
    assert first.has_more is True
    assert first.next_cursor == encode_offset(2)

    second = paginate_cursor(items, first.next_cursor, per_page=2)
    assert second.items == [2, 3]
    assert second.has_more is True

    third = paginate_cursor(items, second.next_cursor, per_page=2)
    assert third.items == [4]
    assert third.has_more is False
    assert third.next_cursor is None


def test_cursor_has_more_matches_next_cursor() -> None:
    first = paginate_cursor(["a", "b"], per_page=1)
    assert (first.has_more is True) == (first.next_cursor is not None)
    last = paginate_cursor([], per_page=1)
    assert (last.has_more is False) == (last.next_cursor is None)


def test_cursor_empty_and_end_of_items() -> None:
    assert paginate_cursor([], per_page=2) == CursorPage([], None, False)
    full = paginate_cursor(["a", "b"], per_page=2)
    assert full == CursorPage(["a", "b"], None, False)
    beyond = paginate_cursor(["a"], encode_offset(100), per_page=2)
    assert beyond == CursorPage([], None, False)


def test_cursor_does_not_mutate_input() -> None:
    source = ["a", "b", "c"]
    paginate_cursor(source, per_page=2)
    assert source == ["a", "b", "c"]


def test_cursor_validation() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor(["a"], per_page=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor(["a"], "%%%")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor(["a"], encode_offset(-1))


def test_browse_next_is_thin_caller() -> None:
    first = browse_next(["a", "b", "c"], per_page=2)
    assert isinstance(first, CursorPage)
    assert first.items == ["a", "b"]
    assert browse_next(["a", "b", "c"], first.next_cursor, 2).items == ["c"]
